name: t0070 v2 - synaptic-current equations + typeset PDF
short_description: Supersede t0070's writeup: add the canonical I_syn = g_syn(t,V) * (V - E) formula blocks for all 5 synapse mechanisms (bed A AMPA, NMDA, GABA, ACh; bed B Exp2Syn ACh, GABA), rewrite every equation in LaTeX math syntax, and produce a typeset PDF via Typst (single-file pip dep, no LaTeX install).
